'''2009 2K Event Day 1 Chris Terwilliger DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Terwilliger]] at [[2009 2K Event]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
